conclusions: All backend services were reachable and healthy at the time of the check: PostgreSQL, Neo4j 5.26.24 Community, Elasticsearch, Redis, the embeddings service and the reranker.

Elasticsearch reports yellow because all 24 indices carry one replica each and the cluster runs on a single node, so no replica can be allocated. This is expected behaviour, not a fault: the primaries are all started and the data is intact, but there is no redundancy.

Two remedies were offered for the yellow status — set number_of_replicas to 0 across all indices, or add a second node — and setting replicas to 0 was recommended for a single-VPS setup. The user never chose between them.
